summary: The operative verdict is the breaker's toric-exchange cheat against the frozen marked pair-linearized Beneš switch brick. Its hash-locked matrix has shape 54x76. Exact search of 6560 nonzero local {-1,0,1} vectors finds the conformally primitive support-eight movement (1,-1,-1,1,1,-1,-1,1), which preserves every emitted row and equals the honest affine difference h000-h011-h100+h111. Therefore any detector required to vanish on honest affine differences also misses it. All 384 permutation/input fibers admit a zero-residual malformed vector at energy 92 or 108 versus legal energy 76. A separate larger 136x142 target-only serialization has common legal energy 142 and passes its local physical Hamming-one/two kernel checks, but its frozen residual scale 5 is killed by all-zero DROP at energy 692<2414=17*142. These are finite kills of the two serialized local bricks, not every Beneš compiler. Lean proves the universal marking restriction that a square integer matrix with Gram identity is exactly a signed permutation matrix; it does not prove L1, a compiler, or soundness. The pair-supported quaternion strategy remains retired, L1 remains open, and no hardness or dimension-gap claim follows.
hypothesis: Selected the sole cross-review survivor, Fable Proposal 1 / Pro Proposal 1 marked oblivious Beneš routing, with the mandatory restriction that physical and anchor columns move only by color-preserving signed permutations. Causal mechanism: one fixed routing topology should move formula dependence into switch targets while preserving marked coordinates and common legal energy, enabling a full-brick higher-Lawrence L1 induction. Expected frontier move: a target-only marked normal form with no incompatible low-weight kernel class. Falsification condition: any honest-affine malformed primitive, setting-dependent matrix, unequal legal energy, low-weight physical/kernel shortcut, or DROP below threshold. The breaker brick meets the honest-affine falsifier, and the builder brick meets the DROP falsifier.

tests.finding: The hash-locked 136x142 target-only matrix has 384 legal vectors at energy 142, six local weight-eight primitives, and no physical-only Hamming-one/two kernel move among 5832 tests, but all-zero DROP costs 692<2414.

The hash-locked 54x76 switch matrix has a conformally primitive support-eight zero-residual movement equal to h000-h011-h100+h111; all 384 fibers admit attack energy 92 or 108 against legal energy 76.
Both deterministic Python verifiers compile successfully.
Mathlib compiles the integer unit-vector lemma, orthonormal-column signed-permutation classification, and direct Gram-identity corollary.

next_experiment: Freeze one actual full marked width-four brick rather than another local proxy. Include every physical, pair, normalization, glue, DROP, transfer, anchor, NAND, both COPY orientations, occurrence expansion, COPY tree, fanout diamond, and three-COPY cycle through depths 1, 2, and 3, with exact targets, residual Grams, and common legal energy. Use only signed color-preserving permutations on semantic columns and transport residual metrics explicitly. Raise the builder residual scale enough to clear its exact DROP gate, then test the support-eight honest-affine exchange first: any added detector must be nonzero on it without violating honest-equivalence semantics. Compute exact marked kernel identities and complete low-weight/Graver audits including DROP and physical Hamming-one/two changes. Any failed marked identity, surviving honest-affine primitive, or cheap DROP kills the serialization; a finite pass authorizes only an L1 induction attempt.
